detailed_descriptions.en: Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies, go viral, and survive, survive, SURVIVE! Internet Survivor Survivors is a top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame, in which you play as Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!? Lots of other familiar Touhou characters make appearances too, of course! Game Description -Just keep on beating enemies and never stop! ...Hey, haven't I seen these things online before!? -Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons and stats! -For a streamer, their very viewer count is their life! Beat enemies to gain viewers, but get hit and you'll lose some! -If you lose all your viewers, Flan's phone will break and it'll be game over! -Keep streaming until time runs out and you'll clear the stage! -Simple controls let you have stress-free fun! C'mon, just give it a try and you'll see! Story My name's Flandre Scarlet! I'm a newbie streamer, but I've got a LOT of eyes on me! Weird content, fun stuff, freaky memes, whatever... I'll play with all of you, no exceptions! I'm gonna destroy things, grow my numbers, and go viral! My goal is 1 million subs! Just you wait, big sis Remilia! I'll catch up to you in no time! About This Game This game is a fangame based on the Touhou Project series, and isn't an official work created by Team Shanghai Alice.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies, go viral, and survive, survive, SURVIVE!

Internet Survivor Survivors is a top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame,

in which you play as Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!?

Lots of other familiar Touhou characters make appearances too, of course!

Game Description

-Just keep on beating enemies and never stop! ...Hey, haven't I seen these things online before!?

-Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons and stats!

-For a streamer, their very viewer count is their life! Beat enemies to gain viewers, but get hit and you'll lose some!

-If you lose all your viewers, Flan's phone will break and it'll be game over!

-Keep streaming until time runs out and you'll clear the stage!

-Simple controls let you have stress-free fun! C'mon, just give it a try and you'll see!

Story

My name's Flandre Scarlet! I'm a newbie streamer, but I've got a LOT of eyes on me!

Weird content, fun stuff, freaky memes, whatever... I'll play with all of you, no exceptions!

I'm gonna destroy things, grow my numbers, and go viral! My goal is 1 million subs!

Just you wait, big sis Remilia! I'll catch up to you in no time!

About This Game

This game is a fangame based on the Touhou Project series,

and isn't an official work created by Team Shanghai Alice.
